record.question: Which reformer is correctly matched with the socio-religious organisation he led or inspired, and what was one major focus of that organisation?
options: Jyotiba Phule – Satyashodhak Samaj; challenging caste oppression and promoting education among lower castes
Swami Vivekananda – Aligarh Movement; advocating Western-style scientific education for Muslims
Sir Syed Ahmad Khan – Ramakrishna Mission; preaching a synthesis of Vedanta and devotion
Keshab Chandra Sen – Arya Samaj; promoting exclusive Vedic ritualism
